audit_items.proof_trace: The branch condition `debt_amount <= amount` (line 179) uses the ceiling of the actual decimal debt; if false (`debt_amount > amount`), one can prove `self.amount.value >= amount * WAD + 1`, so `sub(self.amount, from(amount))` in `debt.move::unsafe_decrease` never underflows. Both callers (`repay_debt` and the liquidation path) accrue interest before invoking `unsafe_repay_debt_only`, ensuring the stored `self.amount` is current.
